about.intro: Engineering, space and everything in between. I build things, ask questions and keep notes on what I find.
about.body:
Hello, I'm Burak Kül, a Turkish student with big dreams and a huge curiosity about space and engineering. However, my interests aren't limited to these two fields. I'm also passionate about mathematics, physics, chemistry, philosophy, and politics.

I dream of becoming an aerospace engineer one day, and my ultimate goal in life is to establish my own space company.

I've always been curious about how things work and how different systems operate. But about three years ago, my curiosity about space began to outweigh all my other interests.

I believe a new era of space exploration is approaching, and I want to be part of it — not just as an engineer, but as someone who helps lead the way towards the exploration of space and the advancement of humanity.
